chapterTitle: Chapter 6 An Overview of Organic Reactions
title: Problem 6-13

pages.text: PROBLEM 6-13 Sketch an energy diagram for a two-step reaction in which both steps are exergonic and in which the second step has a higher-energy transition state than the first. Label the parts of the diagram corresponding to reactant, product, intermediate, overall ΔG‡, and overall ΔG°.
